/scripts.value:
on FixMenuLoc
	global gSelectedPlatform
	local tGroupName // THE VARIABLE USED FOR THIS IS SET TO THE 'RECORD ID' OF THE GROUP
	local tStack
	
	 // SET STACK 
	if exists(stack "Appli_Player") = true then 
		 put "Appli_Player" into tStack
		 else 
		 put "Appli" into tStack
	 end if
	
	put actionMenuElementID into tGroupName
	put "appligroup cs control " before tGroupName 
	
	// VARIABLES ARE SET
	
	if the bottom of group tGroupName of stack tStack > the bottom of group gSelectedPlatform of stack tStack then
		//set the bottom of group tGroupName of stack tStack to the bottom of group gSelectedPlatform of stack tStack
		set_the_property tGroupName, "top", the bottom of group gSelectedPlatform of stack tStack - the height of group tGroupName of stack tStack
	end if
	
	if the right of group tGroupName of stack tStack > the right of group gSelectedPlatform of stack tStack then
		//set the right of group tGroupName of stack tStack to the right of group gSelectedPlatform of stack tStack
		set_the_property tGroupName, "left", the right of group gSelectedPlatform of stack tStack - the width of group tGroupName of stack tStack
	end if 
end FixMenuLoc
